metadata.purpose: Mirror the source exactly and invoke a zero-argument teardown callback once on complete, error, or explicit unsubscribe.

conditions: All next values and terminal notifications retain source identity/order.
The callback itself contributes no stream value and its return value is ignored.
Cω counts next values; terminal notifications, cancellation and resource release are separate obligations.

scope.parameters: One zero-argument callback; no other options.
scope.callbacks: The finalizer is represented as an invoke-callback action with no meaningful input value; callback return is not a stream event.
scope.time: No scheduler or timer. Finalization is part of subscription teardown ordering.
scope.reentrancy: The pure model treats finalizer invocation as an atomic teardown action and excludes callback reentry/throws.
exclusions: Throwing finalizer behavior, nested unsubscription from observer handlers, deprecated synchronous error handling details.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one source subscription only when the result is subscribed.

ownership.sharing: No sharing is introduced; each result subscription owns independent state and resources.
ownership.reset: A fresh result subscription starts from Unsubscribed; Closed rejects all later model events.

resources.owner: registered teardown callback for this result subscription

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret ordered actions. Callback actions are requests to external user functions, never executed by the pure model.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; cancellation releases owned work and emits no synthetic completion.

inputs.description: source fails with its original error object

controls.description: terminal execution; no later model events are legal
